info.title: Laravel Calendar Service API
info.description: RESTful API specification for managing calendars, working hours, blocked times, availability, and events.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search on the calendar name.

example.notes: Office closed for annual summer break.

parameters.name: slot_interval_minutes
parameters.description: Step size used while generating candidate slots.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Timezone used to render returned slots. Defaults to the calendar timezone.

parameters.name: assignee_id
parameters.description: Filter events assigned to a given user.

parameters.name: created_by
parameters.description: Filter events created by a given user.

parameters.name: updated_by
parameters.description: Filter events last updated by a given user.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Filter by additional metadata properties using deepObject syntax, for example metadata[priority]=high.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search on event number, title, or description.

EventRevision.name: revision
EventRevision.description: Return the specified historical event revision. Omit this filter to return the latest revision.

StartsFromFilter.name: starts_from
StartsFromFilter.description: Return records with start timestamps on or after this value.

EndsBeforeFilter.name: ends_before
EndsBeforeFilter.description: Return records with end timestamps before or equal to this value.

IncludeCalendarRelations.name: include
IncludeCalendarRelations.description: Comma-separated related data to embed. Supported values: working_hours, blocked_times.

IncludeEventRelations.name: include
IncludeEventRelations.description: Comma-separated event-related data to embed. Supported values: assignees, sources.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required or has failed.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current resource state, typically due to overlapping events.

message.example: The requested resource was not found.

errors.description: Validation errors grouped by field path.

ends_at: The ends_at field must be a date after starts_at.

UserReference.description: Normalized user reference with a resource kind and UUID identifier.

kind.description: Resource kind of the user reference.

id.description: Primary key of the related user.

SourceReference.description: External or cross-system source reference linked to the event.

kind.description: Source kind, such as google_calendar_event, microsoft_graph_event, imported_csv_row, or crm_booking.

provider.description: Name of the upstream provider or source system.

id.description: Stable identifier from the upstream provider.

synced_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful sync for this source reference.

metadata.description: Optional provider-specific attributes related to the source reference.

Location.description: Optional physical or virtual location attached to the event.

label.description: Short display label for the location.

address.description: Postal address or room details for in-person events.

meeting_url.description: Join URL for a virtual meeting.

Recurrence.description: Recurrence rules used when the event belongs to a repeating series.

interval.description: Number of frequency units between each occurrence.

count.description: Optional maximum number of generated occurrences.

until.description: Optional end boundary for the recurring series.

by_week_days.description: Days of the week used for weekly recurrence patterns.

WorkingHoursRule.description: Default weekly working-hours rule for a calendar.

start_time.description: Daily start time in 24-hour HH:MM format.

end_time.description: Daily end time in 24-hour HH:MM format.

BlockedTime.description: Special blocked period that overrides normal availability.

id.description: Primary key of the blocked-time record.

starts_at.description: Start of the blocked period in ISO 8601 format.

ends_at.description: End of the blocked period in ISO 8601 format.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation for the blocked period.

notes.description: Optional extra context for the blocked period.
notes.example: Office closed for annual summer break.

Calendar.description: A calendar resource used to group events, availability, and scheduling context.

owner_id.description: External owner reference stored as a UUID.

timezone.description: Default IANA timezone context for this calendar.

working_hours.description: Default weekly working hours for this calendar, interpreted in the calendar timezone.

blocked_times.description: Special blocked periods that override normal availability.

working_hours.description: Weekly working hours to replace. Omit to remove all existing working hours.

blocked_times.description: Blocked times to replace. Omit to preserve existing blocked times.

notes.description: Optional extra context. Omit this property to remove existing notes.

Event.description: An event resource that represents a scheduled record on a calendar, including revision metadata, recurrence context, ownership, and operational metadata.

calendar_id.description: Primary key of the calendar that owns this event.

sources.description: Upstream or cross-system source references connected to this event.

parent_event_id.description: Optional parent event identifier when this record is derived from another event.

series_master_event_id.description: Optional master-series event identifier for recurring instances or exceptions.

event_number.description: Human-friendly event reference for support, invoices, or operator workflows.

title.description: Short human-readable title of the event.

description.description: Optional long-form notes or business context for the event.
description.example: Planning session for Q3 roadmap with engineering and product leads.

revision.description: Automatically assigned revision number for this version of the event. Each change creates a new revision; use it to retrieve a historical version.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to interpret the event schedule.

starts_at.description: Inclusive start timestamp of the event in ISO 8601 format.

ends_at.description: Exclusive end timestamp of the event in ISO 8601 format.

all_day.description: Whether the event spans the full local calendar day rather than a time range.

blocks_availability.description: Whether the event prevents another availability-blocking event from overlapping its time range in the same calendar.

duration_minutes.description: Total booked duration in minutes for faster filtering and reporting.

buffer_before_minutes.description: Optional preparation time reserved immediately before the event.

buffer_after_minutes.description: Optional wrap-up time reserved immediately after the event.

assignees.description: Users responsible for owning or operating the event.

updated_reason.description: Optional explanation for the latest event change.
updated_reason.example: Rescheduled after the customer requested a later start time.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the event was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the event was last updated.

notes.description: Internal operational notes that should not necessarily be displayed to end users.
notes.example: Room access code will be shared 15 minutes before the event starts.

metadata.description: Flexible extension point for provider-specific or domain-specific attributes.
